title: Manuel pratique de la culture maraîchère de Paris
author: Moreau & Daverne
description_en: A foundational manual detailing the intensive Parisian market-gardening system, including soil preparation, rotations, and productivity techniques.

title: Guide pratique du jardinier français
author: Ph. Desmoulins
description_en: An encyclopedic alphabetical guide covering vegetables, fruit trees, ornamentals, pests, and general horticultural practice in France.

title: L’école du jardin potager
author: Mme de Guercy née Prévost
description_en: A pedagogical, month-by-month guide to vegetable gardening and basic field crops intended for practical instruction.

title: L’horticulture dans les écoles primaires
author: Bidault
description_en: An educational treatise advocating horticulture as a practical and moral discipline in French primary schools.

title: La culture maraîchère pratique des environs de Paris
author: I. Ponce
description_en: A detailed description of professional market-gardening practices around Paris, focused on intensive production and urban supply.

title: Le jardin potager
author: L.-J. Troncet
description_en: An illustrated practical handbook on establishing, managing, and protecting a productive vegetable garden.

title: Le jardinier de tout le monde
author: Alexandre Ysabeau
description_en: A comprehensive gardening manual for amateurs and professionals covering vegetables, fruit, ornamentals, and greenhouses.

title: Le petit jardin potager et fruitier

description_en: A concise guide for managing small household vegetable and fruit gardens efficiently.

title: Le potager d’un curieux
author: A. Paillieux & D. Bois
description_en: A pioneering exploration of rare, exotic, and neglected edible plants combining botany, experimentation, and culinary use.

title: Le potager, essai didactique
author: J.-B. Lalanne
description_en: A didactic and literary essay reflecting on vegetable gardening through dialogue, philosophy, and observation.

title: Le potager moderne
author: Gressent
description_en: A modernized guide to vegetable gardening emphasizing efficiency, rational methods, and adaptation to contemporary needs.

title: L’école du jardin potager
author: M. de Combles
description_en: An early systematic horticultural manual covering vegetable species, soils, climates, and propagation techniques.

title: Les jardiniers de Paris et leur culture
author: J. Curé
description_en: A historical and socio-economic study of Parisian market gardeners and the evolution of their cultivation methods.

title: Ma pratique de la culture maraîchère ordinaire et forcée
author: J. Curé

title: Manuel complet du jardinier maraîcher, pépiniériste, botaniste, fleuriste et paysagiste

title: Manuel de culture maraîchère

title: Manuel du jardinier des primeurs

title: Manuel pratique de jardinage
author: Courtois-Gérard
description_en: A widely used general gardening manual for vegetables, fruit, and ornamentals, regularly updated through editions.

title: Les plantes potagères et la culture maraîchère
author: Jean Dybowski
description_en: A scientifically grounded reference combining vegetable botany with commercial-scale cultivation practices.

title: Traité de culture potagère (petite et grande culture)
author: Jean Dybowski
description_en: An authoritative synthesis of vegetable production methods for both household gardens and large-scale agriculture.

title: Le jardin potager : notions pratiques de culture maraîchère
author: Alexandre Ysabeau
description_en: A clear and accessible practical manual explaining tools, soils, irrigation, and vegetable cultivation for market gardening.
